items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: you had a number of fine people ... that had been in your bands. There was another I just thought I'd ask you about, was Richie Kamuka. Yes.

ctx.x: And you read it because you're supposed to, but not because it influences you one way or the other, or makes any big color in your life.

Uh-huh. Let's see. Oh, you had a number of fine people -- you've already mentioned, who are no longer with us anymore that had been in your bands. There was another I just thought I'd ask you about, was Richie Kamuka.
